description: Is the site working: availability, errors, latency, Solr, Celery and the pods.

spec.title: Requests by status class
spec.description: Requests per second, stacked by status class.

spec.title: 5xx by route
spec.description: Server errors per second by route and status. retrieve-manifest 502s are upstream libraries (see the usage dashboard).

spec.title: Latency percentiles
spec.description: Django response time, manifest proxy excluded.

spec.title: p95 latency by route (slowest 10)
spec.description: Which routes are slow.

spec.title: Requests in progress vs workers
spec.description: Requests being handled right now against the number of sync gunicorn workers; at the line, new requests queue.

spec.title: DB queries per request (p95, by route)
spec.description: Database queries issued while handling one request; a jump means an N+1 query.

spec.title: Unhandled exceptions
spec.description: Exceptions that escaped a view (each was a 500 for the reader).

spec.title: Worker timeouts and exits
spec.description: Gunicorn workers aborted for exceeding the 600s timeout, and workers that exited for any reason.

spec.title: Probe result per target
spec.description: Blackbox probe every 60s. / is DNS, TLS, ingress, nginx, Django; manuscripts adds Postgres; search adds Solr.

spec.title: Site up
spec.description: Edge probe from outside the cluster: home page, manuscripts (Postgres) and search (Solr). Down if any target fails.

spec.title: Probe duration per target
spec.description: Time for the full request from the blackbox exporter.

spec.title: Solr requests by operation and outcome
spec.description: Requests from the app, worker and exporter to Solr. rejected = Solr refused the query (bad search syntax).

spec.title: Solr p95 latency by operation
spec.description: Including client retries.

spec.title: Solr JVM heap
spec.description: Used against max. CantusSolrHeapHigh fires above 90% for 15 minutes.

spec.title: Sync sessions by outcome
spec.description: Batches of database changes pushed to Solr by the save/delete signals.

spec.title: Inventory collection errors
spec.description: Failed reads by the metrics exporter; short spikes during deploys are expected.

spec.title: celery queue
spec.description: Messages waiting (ready) and taken but not yet acknowledged (unacked).

spec.title: Task runs by task and outcome
spec.description: Celery task executions.

spec.title: Requests/s
spec.description: All requests Django handled.

spec.title: Tasks in progress
spec.description: Tasks executing now (the worker runs one at a time).

spec.title: Task duration p95
spec.description: Execution time per task.

spec.title: Queue wait p95
spec.description: Time from publish to a worker starting the task.

spec.title: Oldest unfinished task
spec.description: Age of the oldest task result still queued or started. CantusCeleryTaskStuck fires above 6 hours.

spec.title: Consumers on celery
spec.description: Workers consuming the task queue. CantusCeleryNoConsumer fires at 0.

spec.title: RabbitMQ alarms
spec.description: Memory, disk and file-descriptor alarms; any alarm blocks publishers.

spec.title: Container restarts
spec.description: Restarts in production pods; CantusPodRestarted fires on each.

spec.title: Memory used / limit
spec.description: Working set as a share of the memory limit. Above 90% for 15 minutes fires CantusMemoryNearLimit; at 100% the container is OOM-killed.

spec.expr: max by (pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="cantus-ultimus", pod!~".*staging.*", container!=""}) / on (pod, container) max by (pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="cantus-ultimus", resource="memory"})

spec.title: CPU by container
spec.description: CPU cores used.

spec.title: 5xx
spec.description: Share of responses that were 5xx, manifest proxy excluded (as in CantusHighErrorRate, which fires at 5%).

spec.title: Volume free space
spec.description: Free share of each production volume; CantusVolumeFillingUp fires below 15%. Most are node disks shared with other workloads.

spec.expr: min by (persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{namespace="cantus-ultimus", persistentvolumeclaim!~".*staging.*"}) / max by (persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{namespace="cantus-ultimus", persistentvolumeclaim!~".*staging.*"})

spec.title: p95 latency
spec.description: 95th percentile Django response time, manifest proxy excluded. CantusSlowResponses fires above 2s.

spec.title: Busy workers
spec.description: Requests in progress over gunicorn workers. CantusWorkersSaturated fires at 90% for 10 minutes.

spec.title: Firing alerts
spec.description: Cantus Ultimus alerts firing now (routed to #cantus-ultimus-alerts).

spec.title: Running build
spec.description: Git commit of the app image the pods are running.

title: Cantus Ultimus — Service health
